title: Vercel v0 Pricing: Plans, Credits & Limits (2026 Guide) | UI Bakery Blog

facts.fact: The Vercel v0 Free plan includes $5 in monthly credits, according to this UI Bakery blog post.
facts.quote: $5 in monthly credits, access to v0-1.5-md, deploy to Vercel

facts.fact: The Vercel v0 Pro plan costs $20 per user per month and includes $20 in credits, according to this UI Bakery blog post.
facts.quote: $20/user/month, $20 in credits, v0-1.5-lg, Figma import, v0 API

facts.fact: The Vercel v0 Team plan costs $30 per user per month and includes $30 in credits per user, according to this UI Bakery blog post.
facts.quote: $30/user/month, $30 in credits per user, shared billing, v0 API

facts.fact: The Vercel v0 Enterprise plan is priced on a custom basis, according to this UI Bakery blog post.
facts.quote: custom pricing, SAML SSO, training opt-out, priority access

facts.fact: According to this blog post, additional Vercel v0 credits can be purchased on the Pro and Team plans beyond the monthly allowance.
facts.quote: Additional credits can be purchased on Pro and Team plans beyond the monthly allowance.

facts.fact: The blog post states that the Vercel v0 Pro plan has a 5× higher attachment size limit than the Free plan.
The blog post states that Vercel v0 imposes no usage limits currently on basic generation.
facts.quote: There are no usage limits currently imposed on basic generation.

facts.fact: In the blog's comparison table, UI Bakery is listed with a free tier and paid plans from $4 per month; this is the publisher's own claim about a competitor.
In the blog's comparison table, Bolt AI is listed with paid plans from approximately $20 per month; this is the publisher's estimate, not a verified vendor price.
In the blog's comparison table, Lovable AI is listed with paid plans from approximately $25 per month; this is the publisher's estimate.
The blog's FAQ states that Vercel v0 credits are consumed per generation and that Pro users receive $20 per month, Team users receive $30 per user per month, and Free users receive $5 per month.
facts.quote: Free users get $5/month; Pro users get $20/month; Team users get $30/user/month.
